method: Claude Fable 5.1, a different model from the one that answered, marked each answer using the prompt and rubric in evals/judge.ts. It was given only the page text, the questions and the replies. Its marks are recorded verbatim, and code adds up the totals.

current-role.answer: Harry is a Lead Quality AI Engineer. The site doesn’t name his employer.
current-role.reason: The role is correct and it rightly declines to guess an employer, but it paraphrases the uncovered part instead of using the required reply "That isn’t covered on this site."

experience.answer: Harry has nine years in quality engineering (the site lists 9+ years in quality and test engineering), from regression testing core banking systems to leading quality for AI products.
experience.reason: Every claim matches the portfolio and the question is answered, with a small loss for the slightly clumsy parenthetical that says nine and 9+ in the same sentence.

test-design.answer: He shows it on this site’s start sequence: an AI test-design agent turns the user story into seven acceptance criteria, maps the states and risks, picks techniques such as state transition and negative testing, and drafts 14 prioritised test cases, with a tester reviewing every step. A coverage matrix then traces every criterion to its tests, and the one gap it found became a new automated test.
test-design.reason: An accurate and complete summary of the process within the word limit, with a small loss for a very long opening sentence.

site-testing.answer: Every control has a stable data-testid and is covered by Playwright end-to-end tests on desktop and mobile Chromium, plus visual regression screenshots, axe accessibility scans, and CSP and privacy checks. GitHub Actions runs lint, type checks and the full suite on every change, only a green run can deploy, and each deploy publishes its own test results. Visitors can also run live checks in their own browser.
site-testing.reason: All the testing claims are supported by the portfolio and the answer is thorough, though it is a dense list that uses the term data-testid without explanation.

automation.answer: It picks up task notification emails from his inbox, keeps only those from the source system, pulls out the title, due date, priority and a link to the original task, skips anything already on the board, then creates a card on the task board he built and files the email away. He built it with AI in Power Automate and tested it with sample emails.
automation.reason: It follows the flow's steps faithfully and stays within the word limit, with a small loss because the first sentence strings six steps together.
